proposed_comments.title: Finish hardening abandoned handle-enumeration workers
proposed_comments.body:
### Finish hardening abandoned handle-enumeration workers

**Severity:** `high`

This change avoids `TerminateThread`, but the replacement path still has to make detached workers safe for the full time they may remain blocked. Please make each worker own or copy every callable dependency it may use after `handles()` returns, prevent an abandoned worker from claiming more handle indices after the watchdog gives up on it, and bound abandoned workers across repeated File Locksmith reloads rather than only within a single enumeration call. Because this code lives in an unloadable interop DLL, the worker also needs to pin the module before it is launched and keep that pin until the worker actually exits; otherwise a worker that later unblocks can resume in unloaded code.
